campaign.title: Rename HAS_CREDIT to HAS_NONNEGATIVE_CREDIT, preserving identity, bindings and behavior.

initial.code:
FUNCTION HAS_CREDIT(X)
  HAS_CREDIT = 0
  IF (X >= 0) THEN
    HAS_CREDIT = 1
  END IF
  HAS_CREDIT = HAS_CREDIT
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION IS_MINOR(X)
  IS_MINOR = 0
  IF (X < 18) THEN
    IS_MINOR = 1
  END IF
  IS_MINOR = IS_MINOR
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION CAN_APPLY(X)
  CAN_APPLY = 0
  IF (HAS_CREDIT(X) >= 1) THEN
    CAN_APPLY = 1
  END IF
  IF (IS_MINOR(X) >= 1) THEN
    CAN_APPLY = 0
  END IF
  CAN_APPLY = CAN_APPLY
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION APPROVAL_FLAG(X)
  APPROVAL_FLAG = 0
  IF (CAN_APPLY(X) >= 1) THEN
    APPROVAL_FLAG = 1
  END IF
  APPROVAL_FLAG = APPROVAL_FLAG
END FUNCTION
